summary: This configures a test suite to use the TestCase class from the Tests namespace for all test files in the Feature directory. It's a setup line that tells the test runner which base class to inherit from and which folder to apply it to.

explanations.1: uses() is a Pest PHP function that applies a configuration (in this case, the TestCase class) to all test files in the specified directory. It's like saying 'make all tests in Feature use this base class'.
